title: Lecture Theatre
shortDescription: Chalk constellations climb above tiers of polished benches.
longDescription:
Curved benches rise around a lectern worn smooth at the corners. High windows lay bars of light across drifting chalk dust, giving the impression that somebody has diagrammed the sunshine.
On the blackboard, six different explanations of the same falling apple compete for space. One small sentence has been circled twice.

fixtures.name: Blackboard
fixtures.examineDescription: 'What did you notice, and what makes you think so?' The apple diagrams offer heat, roots, illusion, stars, stone, and a very practical catching hand. A note from Alder says: 'An unanswered question is not a failed lesson. It is tomorrow's beginning.'
